name: @rop/operator-shell
description: Electron shell for the restaurant operator app: kiosk, printing, auto-update.

scripts.dist: pnpm --filter @rop/operator build && node esbuild.config.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm --filter @rop/operator build && node esbuild.config.mjs && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm --filter @rop/operator build && node esbuild.config.mjs && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never

x-notes: CommonJS on purpose (no "type": "module"): Electron main/preload compile to CJS.
Names come from the repo-root brand.config.json: esbuild bakes it into the bundle as __BRAND__, electron-builder.config.cjs requires it.
Build-time env: SUPABASE_URL (or VITE_SUPABASE_URL) is baked into the CSP connect-src by esbuild.config.mjs; dev adds the local stack.
